President Donald Trump granted Arpaio a full pardon on August 25, 2017, before sentencing. The Justice Department’s clemency list records the offense as contempt of court and lists no sentence. In a later order, the district court explained that the pardon spared Arpaio from punishment but did not revise the historical facts of the case. These records support a factual account of the contempt finding and pardon. They do not establish that Trump issued the pardon in exchange for political loyalty or that the clemency was corrupt, so the original “Corrupt Pardons” subcategory is removed.
